title: r35#2 候选弹窗（从“有 N 张候选”入口）

steps.js: const m=document.querySelector('.ds-modal, [role=dialog]'); if(!m) return {modal:false}; const txt=m.innerText; const titles=[...m.querySelectorAll('[title],[alt],[data-zoom-label]')].map(e=>(e.title||'')+' '+(e.alt||'')+' '+(e.getAttribute('data-zoom-label')||'')).join(' '); return {modal:true, cls:m.className, head:txt.slice(0,300).split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' '), internal:((txt+' '+titles).match(/ASSETMASTER|PRODUCER|接手登记/g)||[]), recipe:((txt+' '+titles).match(/新配方|旧配方/g)||[]).length, labels:[...new Set((txt+' '+titles).match(/暂定|新配方|旧配方|候选 ?#[0-9]+/g)||[])].slice(0,20)};

const r=document.querySelector('.v3-row[data-shot="ep02-S1"]'); const f=[...r.querySelectorAll('.v3-frames .v3-frame')][1]; const rg=[...f.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/再生成/.test(b.textContent)); return {tileCursor:getComputedStyle(f).cursor, title:f.title, regenText:rg?.textContent, regenInner:rg?.innerText, regenAria:rg?.getAttribute('aria-label')};

title: r35#2 尾帧候选弹窗：点“暂定”标签

steps.clickAt: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('.v3-row[data-shot="ep02-S1"]'); const t=[...r.querySelectorAll('.v3-frames .v3-frame')][1]; const l=t.querySelector('.v3-cand-lbl'); const b=(l||t).getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.x+b.width/2, b.y+b.height/2]; })()
